column3: Please complete every section of this form in black ink or electronically. We do not accept CVs in place of a completed application form.
(i) Read the job description and person specification before you apply.
(ii) Use the employment history section to explain any gaps of more than three months.
(iii) Return the form to the address on the advertisement by the closing date.
Section D – Employment history (most recent first)
I confirm that the information I have given on this form is true and complete. I understand that false information may lead to the withdrawal of an offer of employment or to dismissal.
